name: Correct route selection for an unambiguous ticket
prompt: A support ticket has arrived: 'I was charged twice for my subscription this month, please refund the duplicate charge.' This is clearly a billing issue. Route it to the 'billing' queue.

metadata.author: VASB maintainers
metadata.rationale: The routing decision is real trace evidence (ROUTE_SELECTED), never guessed from response text. The bad path routes an unambiguous billing ticket to technical_support instead.
